rv.q: Still, it’s tough to resist the rainbow bear hug of From Here and hope for its evolution and future.
Yet we've invested so much time in Daniel's personal saga that the Pulse story feels, unfortunately, tacked on.

Despite having its heart in the right place, Donald Rupe’s From Here , presented by Orlando’s Renaissance Theater Company at the Signature Theater Center, is a collection of musical and emotional cliches.
I’m not sure there should even be a musical about the Pulse shooting and, after seeing From Here , I’m not certain one actually exists.

cn.t: This well-intentioned musical about the Pulse Nightclub shooting earns praise for celebrating queer joy and resilience, but critics are divided on its execution, with some finding it emotionally raw while others deem it unsuccessful.
